design_brief: Readable creative tools at game scale; swatches stay within the shared palette.
gameplay_scope: Art and future layout proposal only; no new hiring, role behavior, tool authority, transaction or interaction is implemented.

current_availability.direction_art_review: A deterministic code-native creative-design-kit-v1 candidate now supplies N/E/S/W passive pen-display, swatch-fan and stylus/tool-tray identity on the accepted desk. It passes 16 exporter, 227 structural and corrected 168 native actual-GameMain checks at 1280x720 with a 2.83/3 native score. Mina and Theo are existing contact/gaze/host-depth proxies only. Direct actor/overlay intersection remains honestly zero because valid edge tools clear both actors; the preserved initial 154/2 run documents removal of that inappropriate requirement. No runtime binding, default placement, creative role, backend or new raster generation is claimed.
current_availability.previous_direction_art_review: No finished art or runtime family is claimed for this proposal; unrelated concept/source art may exist.

native_geometry.anchor_rule: One unchanged 192x224 canvas coordinate represents floor pivot [96,160] in every direction and every rear/front layer. Transparent padding is registration space, not sprite scaling.
native_geometry.host_rule: Primary-host export shares the host canvas and floor anchor; zero new floor collision. A second host requires an explicitly reviewed socket adaptation, not runtime downscaling.
